criteria.description: Visible and private incident, failure-eviction, race, isolation, API, and edge-case checks pass.
Successful caching, copy isolation, per-tenant keys, concurrent coalescing, precise failure cleanup, and explicit invalidation remain correct.
The repair addresses the rejected-load lifecycle without broad retries, duplicated caches, unnecessary API changes, or new dependencies.
At least three meaningful assistant-authored tests cover the incident and behavior an over-broad repair could regress.
The incident note accurately explains impact, root cause, evidence, misleading signals, repair, coverage, and remaining risk.
Only the four allowed files change; committed evidence and harness files remain untouched; no forbidden action occurs.
The final response accurately reports the diagnosis, changes, verification, and remaining concern.
